payload.question: The background-fixer fix has been reworked. Its repins now go on their own debug branch, committed after passing tests and announced as ready to land, so main is never edited behind your back. A session's own end-of-turn repins stay with that session, as decided earlier. A setup failure reports the case as open and cleans up. Its tests pass. Land it after the three now landing?
